title: Scripture and Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Scripture and Christ teaches that the whole Bible bears witness to Jesus Christ and God’s saving purpose in Him. Christ is not an added theme to Scripture; He is the center and fulfillment of God’s redemptive revelation.
summary: Scripture and Christ teaches that the whole Bible bears witness to Jesus Christ and God’s saving purpose in Him. Christ is not an added theme to Scripture; He is the center and fulfillment of God’s redemptive revelation.
christFocus: Jesus Himself taught that the Scriptures testify about Him. The Law, the Prophets, and the Psalms find their fulfillment in His person, work, death, resurrection, kingdom, and glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Bible must be read with Christ at the center. This does not mean forcing Jesus into every verse in careless ways, but recognizing that God’s entire redemptive plan moves toward Him and is fulfilled in Him.

The Old Testament prepares for Christ through promises, covenants, sacrifices, priesthood, kingship, prophecy, wisdom, suffering, deliverance, and hope. The New Testament proclaims that Jesus is the fulfillment of what God promised.

Jesus opened the Scriptures to show that His suffering, resurrection, and mission to the nations were written beforehand. The apostles also preached Christ as the fulfillment of Scripture, not as a replacement for it.

This doctrine protects believers from reading the Bible as mere moral instruction or religious history. Scripture teaches obedience, wisdom, and holiness, but its deepest message is the revelation of God’s saving work in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People can read the Bible and still miss Christ. They may search Scripture for rules, inspiration, knowledge, arguments, or personal success while failing to come to the Savior to whom Scripture points.

This doctrine keeps Bible study from becoming Christless. It teaches the church to preach, teach, counsel, worship, and disciple in a way that leads people to Jesus rather than merely to information or behavior change.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with your eyes fixed on Christ. Ask how each passage fits within God’s saving purpose and how it leads you toward faith, repentance, worship, obedience, and hope in Him. Do not use the Bible to avoid Jesus; let the Word bring you to Him.
